chunks: Rijal al-Kashshi: Hamduwayh ibn Nusayr from Ayyub ibn Nuh from Safwan ibn Yahya from Dawud ibn Farqad who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: My companions are the people of discernment and god-consciousness, so whoever is not from the people of discernment and god-consciousness, then he is not from my companions.
ai.seo_question: What are the defining characteristics of the true companions of the Imam according to Rijal al-Kashshi?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kashi's *Rijal*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) establishes a qualitative criterion for companionship, linking 'al-nahw' (intellectual discernment) with 'at-taqwa' (piety) to distinguish true adherents from mere nominal followers. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the integration of reason and spirituality, where intellectual depth serves as a foundation for spiritual purity. The exclusion of those lacking these traits underscores the concept of *Sahibah* as a spiritual elite rather than a general social group.
